source_quality_scale.4: official primary UK regulator guidance; current duty, control, assessment, reporting or training requirement verified
source_quality_scale.3: official primary source with a material worker, workplace, equipment, exposure, operating-condition or time applicability caveat

quality_guards: Manual-handling risk depends on the load, posture, frequency, distance, worker capability, environment and available controls.
HSE manual-handling guidance is task-, load-, worker-, workplace-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Noise risk depends on sound level, peak pressure, duration, frequency content, task, hearing protection, worker susceptibility and exposure history.
HSE noise evidence is workplace-, task-, worker-, control-, measurement- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level hearing-loss probability.
Workplace-transport risk depends on site layout, vehicle type, traffic volume, visibility, reversing, pedestrian behaviour, driver competence and maintenance.
HSE workplace-transport evidence is site-, vehicle-, driver-, pedestrian-, operation-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Legionella risk depends on water-system design, temperature, stagnation, aerosol generation, maintenance, occupancy, susceptibility and control performance.
HSE legionella evidence is system-, building-, user-, maintenance-, monitoring-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
DSE risk depends on workstation setup, posture, duration, breaks, equipment, lighting, visual demand, worker needs and work organisation.
HSE DSE evidence is workstation-, worker-, equipment-, routine-, environment-, intervention- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level musculoskeletal probability.
RPE performance depends on contaminant, concentration, protection factor, face fit, wearer condition, task, maintenance and correct use.
HSE RPE evidence is substance-, device-, wearer-, task-, fit-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level respiratory-disease probability.
Welding-fume risk depends on process, metal, consumable, coating, duration, ventilation, extraction, RPE and worker susceptibility.
HSE welding evidence is process-, material-, welder-, ventilation-, control-, exposure- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level cancer probability.
Ionising-radiation risk depends on source, activity, energy, distance, shielding, exposure time, pathway, controls and individual dose history.
HSE radiation evidence is source-, practice-, worker-, dose-, shielding-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level cancer probability.
Young-worker risk depends on age, maturity, experience, task, training, supervision, working hours, health and workplace culture.
HSE young-worker evidence is person-, task-, placement-, supervisor-, training-, workplace- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
First-aid needs depend on workforce size, hazards, work patterns, remoteness, shift coverage, vulnerable people and emergency-service access.
HSE first-aid evidence is workplace-, workforce-, hazard-, shift-, responder-, facility- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level emergency-outcome probability.
Thermal risk depends on air temperature, radiant heat, humidity, airflow, clothing, metabolic workload, hydration and acclimatisation.
HSE temperature evidence is workplace-, weather-, task-, worker-, clothing-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level heat-illness probability.
Lifting risk depends on load, equipment, accessories, configuration, ground, environment, operator competence, planning and supervision.
HSE LOLER evidence is lift-, load-, equipment-, operator-, site-, examination- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level lifting-incident probability.
Work-equipment risk depends on machine design, condition, guarding, energy sources, task, operator competence, inspection and maintenance quality.
HSE PUWER evidence is equipment-, task-, operator-, maintenance-, inspection-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level machinery-injury probability.
Hand-arm-vibration risk depends on acceleration, duration, tool condition, grip, posture, temperature, work pattern and individual susceptibility.
HSE vibration evidence is tool-, task-, worker-, exposure-, control-, health-surveillance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level HAVS probability.
Pressure-system risk depends on fluid, pressure, temperature, volume, materials, corrosion, protective devices, maintenance and operating practice.
HSE pressure-system evidence is system-, fluid-, equipment-, operating-, examination-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level rupture probability.
